lines.en: I lurch as if about to fall.
My throat gurgles.
Slime drips down my arms.
I keep my distance as I move.
My steps leave slime behind.
I am in no hurry to get close.
I puff my cheeks as I walk.
My shadow seems to drip.
The floor is slick; that was me.

lines.zh: 我在找一个投掷的距离
lines.en: I am looking for throwing range.
My smell is sharp.
I wobble along behind you.
I am gathering a mouthful.
Something moves in my throat.
I drip even when standing.
My belly swells.
I am waiting for the right angle.
The slime stuck me to myself.
I spit a little, then swallow it back.
My breathing is wet.
I do not need to come near you.
The floor here is already filthy.
I watch you, judging the distance.
Come a little nearer to me.
My mouth is bulging with something.
I know exactly where you stand.
You are within my range.
I tilt my head, hunting an opening.
No need to run; standing works too.
I saw you raise your hand.
My eyes are small, but accurate.
It will get on you.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的东西漏出来了
lines.en: What was in my mouth leaked out.
You hit me where I was swollen.
That threw off my aim.
I do not yell; my mouth might open.
The sticky stuff splashed everywhere.
I have a dent now.
Did it get on your hands?
I back up two steps and gather again.
Hit me again and I spit on you.

lines.zh: 食物？我正在攒别的东西
lines.en: Food? I am gathering something else.

lines.zh: 你举着它，正好挡在胸前
lines.en: You hold it right in front of your chest.
I do not eat; I spit.

lines.zh: 这东西能让我吐得更远
lines.en: This might make me spit farther.
Feed me and I will skip one spit.
The smells mix badly.
Just smelling makes my throat fuller.
Move that thing away.
I need no bait.
Try throwing it to me.
You bumped me; the slime stuck.

lines.zh: 我差点把嘴里的喷出来
lines.en: I nearly spat out what was in my mouth.
I wobbled but stayed standing.
My body is slippery.

lines.zh: 你被我的肩膀蹭了一下
lines.en: My shoulder scraped you.
Do not shove me; it will come out.
Our collision made a sticky patch.
It is on your hand now.
It will not wipe off; do not bother.
Two steps back is enough.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的东西还没吐完
lines.en: I have not finished what is in my mouth.
Not the right time for this.
I only want a high spot.
That question filled my mouth more.
I am not suited to this.
Keep your distance from me.
My throat will not obey.
Do not split my attention.
It is about to burst out of my mouth.
Ask another time.
I picked it up with a sticky hand.
This thing is very slick.
My sticky hands cannot hold it.
Take it, if you do not mind the mess.
I hold it up higher for you.
It is melting away in my hand.
My hands were never clean.
Drop it and it is truly lost.
Catch it; do not let it drop.
This mouthful is saved for you.
I have your chest in sight.
Do not approach; stay put.
My throat is full.
Move and I let it fly.
Target set; ready.
I spit farther than you think.
You cannot dodge this angle.
I am waiting for you to turn.
This mouthful is for you.
You are already aimed at.
Three breaths, and I let go.
Do not look for cover; I can calculate it.
Standing back is safer for me.
Here it comes; do not blink.
I move to your flank.
I keep ten paces away.
Hiding behind a tree will not help.
I hold it in as I walk.
I have learned your pattern.
I aim a little higher, over the stone.
Do not hug the wall; the angle is perfect.
I wait for you to peek from cover.
My hands keep shaking.
I saved this mouthful a long time.
Your shield will not stop slime.
I can see your shadow.
Flanking will get you nowhere.
Come closer and I spit.
My mouth is starting to make noise.
It is not poison; it is glue.
You should move somewhere else.
I keep predicting your path.
You hesitate; I can tell.
I do not strike; I spit.

lines.zh: 一坨黏的东西飞过去了
lines.en: A lump of slime flies over.
It lands by your feet.
It stuck your leg.
You did not manage to dodge.
I retreat as soon as I spit.
The second mouthful is already up.
Once it sticks, you slow down.
It does not hurt, but it is unpleasant.
You wipe it, and it spreads.
I add one from the side.
Your armor is covered now.
That angle was poor.
I missed; again.
You retreated too fast.
Do not panic if it is on your face.
I still have a few mouthfuls left.
Do not stare at my mouth.
It dries off on its own.
I splattered when I landed.
A smell arrived before me.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，喉咙已经满了
lines.en: I stand here, throat already full.
I dirtied the floor.
I came out of the shadow.
Do you hear the sticky sound?
I appeared with puffed cheeks.
This place needs a ranged hand.
I pick my escape route first.
I am still dripping.
Do not come yet; I am not steady.
The slime left a trail on the wall.
Fire dried the slime on me.
I fell and my sac burst.
Water thinned my slime.
The blast flung my slime about.
The arrow struck my cheek pouch.
The spell burns in my throat.
Nothing left to spit; worse still.
Lightning jolted through me.

lines.zh: 虚空里连滴都落不下去
lines.en: Not even a drip falls in the void.
